title: To my dearest girl
paragraphs: I made this little thing for you because I wanted to give you something you could come back to whenever you needed a little smile.

I want you to know how deserving you are of genuine love, happiness and all the beautiful things life has to offer. Never let your fears or doubts make you forget how special you are, because to me, you're one of the most amazing people I've ever met.
I pray that you win in life, achieve all your dreams and get everything you want. Just know that I'm here for you, and I believe in u with all my heart.
I hope it makes you smile :)
